business_logic.description: Block Given on Rent to Owner Used while tenant is Active
business_logic.spec: Runs on form save. Only when _action = 'edit'. Read the stored CCW_MEMBER_PROFILE row for UNIT_NO. If the stored OCCUPANCY_TYPE = 'R' and the incoming OCCUPANCY_TYPE = 'O', check CCW_TENANT_PROFILE for a row with UNIT_NO = this unit and TENANT_STATUS = 'A' (Active). If the table CCW_TENANT_PROFILE does not exist yet, pass. If an active tenant exists return {"error": "Occupancy cannot be changed to Owner Used while the Tenant Profile is Active. Use Remove Tenant first."}; otherwise return nothing.

business_logic.description: Update Unit Master occupancy status on save
business_logic.spec: Fires on every save (add/update) of the header row. UPDATE CCW_UNIT_MASTER SET OCCUPANCY_STATUS = 'O' WHERE UNIT_NO = <UNIT_NO> when OCCUPANCY_TYPE = 'O' (Owner Used), or 'R' when OCCUPANCY_TYPE = 'R' (Given on Rent). Return {"error": ...} if no unit row was updated (rowcount 0).

business_logic.description: Apply tenant access flags to the Tenant Profile
business_logic.spec: Fires on every save of the header row. If table CCW_TENANT_PROFILE does not exist or has no row for UNIT_NO, do nothing. Otherwise for that unit: if TENANT_LOGIN_ALLOWED = 'N' (or OCCUPANCY_TYPE <> 'R') set CCW_TENANT_PROFILE.LOGIN_ENABLED = 'N'; if SHOW_TENANT_IN_DIRECTORY = 'N' (or OCCUPANCY_TYPE <> 'R') set CCW_TENANT_PROFILE.SHOW_IN_DIRECTORY = 'N'. The tenant's edit right (ALLOW_TENANT_TO_UPDATE_PROFILE) is read live from this profile, so it needs no write. Never turn a flag to 'Y' automatically.

business_logic.description: Block delete with open requests or Active tenant
business_logic.spec: Input: the profile row (UNIT_NO). If table CCW_TENANT_PROFILE exists and has a row for UNIT_NO with TENANT_STATUS = 'A', return {"error": "Unit <UNIT_NO> has an Active tenant. Remove the tenant first."}. If table CCW_FACILITY_REQUEST exists and has rows for UNIT_NO with STATUS NOT IN ('C','X') (not Closed/Cancelled; confirm the real status codes in that table), return {"error": "Unit <UNIT_NO> has open facility requests."}. A table that does not exist yet is skipped. Otherwise return nothing.

validations.name: Unit given on rent
validations.message: A tenant can be added only when the unit is Given on Rent.

business_logic.spec: Receives {action, txn_id, header, details}. Take the Joint Owners lines (form 2) from details. If there are no lines return {"error": "At least one Joint Owner is required."}. Count lines with IS_PRIMARY_OWNER = 'Y'. If the count is not exactly 1 return {"error": "Exactly one Joint Owner must be marked as Primary Owner."}. Also, if the same OWNER_EMAIL (case-insensitive) appears on two lines return an error. Otherwise return nothing.

business_logic.description: No repeated additional business category in the grid
business_logic.spec: Receives {action, txn_id, header, details}. Take the Other Categories lines (form 3) from details (ignore lines marked deleted). If the same CATEGORY_CODE (trimmed, case-insensitive) appears on two or more lines return {"error": "Business category <code> is listed more than once under Additional Business Categories."}. If any line's CATEGORY_CODE equals header BUSINESS_CATEGORY (case-insensitive) return {"error": "Business category <code> is already the primary Business Category."}. Otherwise return nothing. This covers duplicates inside one save, which the per-row must-be-unique check cannot see.
